app.title: Harz Routenplaner
panel.intro: Plan your hike in the Harz: set waypoints, compare routes and download them as GPX for Komoot. Free, no login, no tracking.

export.title: GPX file for Komoot
export.intro: The file contains the selected route with elevations, your waypoints and the stamp points along the route.
export.step2: Open komoot.com in your browser and log in.
export.step3: Go to Profile → Saved routes (planned tours) → “Import a file” and choose the file.
export.tip: Tip: do not tick “Match route to known ways” when importing – otherwise Komoot recalculates the route and it differs from your plan.
export.app: The tour then also appears in the Komoot app under planned tours.
imprint.title: Legal notice (Impressum)
imprint.lawHeading: Information according to § 5 DDG (German Digital Services Act)
imprint.addressMissing: ⚠️ The postal address will be added shortly.
imprint.liability: Routes are calculated automatically from OpenStreetMap data and may contain errors. Paths may be closed, dangerous or gone. Please follow the signs on site and plan your tours at your own responsibility. The operators of linked pages are responsible for their content.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.short: No cookies, no tracking, no analytics, no account, no stored routes.
privacy.browser: Your waypoints, your speed and the language are only stored in your browser (localStorage) so they are still there after a reload. They are not sent to us. You can delete them at any time by clearing the site data in your browser or using “Clear all”.
privacy.routing: When you press “Calculate routes”, your browser sends the coordinates of the waypoints to our server. It calculates the routes and sends them back. The result is kept in memory for up to 60 minutes without any link to your IP address (cache for identical requests) and is not stored permanently or logged. The GPX file is created in your browser.
privacy.server: When you open the page, the server necessarily processes your IP address. For rate limiting (protection against overload) it is kept in memory for at most one minute. No access logs with IP addresses are written, neither by our application nor by the reverse proxy in front of it. The server is operated by Hetzner Online GmbH in Germany. Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in a secure, working service).
privacy.tiles: Your browser loads the map images directly from OpenTopoMap (opentopomap.org) and Waymarked Trails (waymarkedtrails.org). These providers receive your IP address and the map area shown. Without these tiles the map cannot be displayed. Their privacy policies apply.
privacy.rights: You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing and to object (Art. 15–21 GDPR). Please contact the controller named above. You can also lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority, for example the State Commissioner for Data Protection of Lower Saxony.
